headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Convenes Policy Meeting With Benchmark Rate at 23%
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria is set to meet following a rate cut to 23% in September. Annual inflation currently stands at 14.06% while the naira remains under pressure.
why: Nigeria's central bank rate decisions impact credit availability, currency stability, and sovereign debt yields across Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Nigerian Central Bank Policy Rate
impacts.why: Central bank interest rate decisions directly adjust institutional borrowing rates.
